content.value: If you are a patient looking to make a payment,
please click here to Make a Payment

The Payment feature allows the user to make credit card payments including initiating a payment plan. Credit card payments can also be voided and non-credit card (cash/check) payments can be recorded in athenaOne. In addition, credit card payments not made via athenahealth's Credit Card Plus (CCP) can be recorded as having been made, however, we highly recommend using CCP (and /collectpayment).
call allows partners to record payments made via cash, check, or credit card payment outside of athenahealth's Credit Card Plus (CCP) processing.
Do not use this feature if the check is being scanned at the front desk using athenaOne, if a credit card payment is being made within athenaOne via CCP, or a payment is made via API using
. This will result in payments being double counted.
The ecommercemode parameter initiates the use of autoEcommerce departments. When autoEcommerce departments are used, PCI Compliance is encompassed by athena.

primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Accepts patients credit card payment information

trackdata.description: The track data obtained from the credit card swipe. This can be track1 and/or track2 data. In either case, please including the start and end sentinels. ("%" and "?" for track1 and ";" and "?" for track2.)

billingzip.description: The billing zipcode for the credit card.  (Required if track data is not supplied.)

nameoncard.description: The name on the credit card.  (Required if trackdata is not supplied; track 2 does NOT supply name.)  Please truncate at 30 characters. (Max length: 30)

claimpayment.description: A JSON representation of claim ID and payment combinations.  For example, '[ { "1":"1.00"}, { "2":"5.00"} ].'  This indicates a payment of $1 for claim ID #1 and a payment of $5 for claim ID #2.

primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Records the data related to a cash, check, or non-CCP credit card patient payment

postdate.description: The date the payment was made.  Defaulted to today.

checknumber.description: The check number.  This is required if the payment is made by check.

copayamount.description: The amount associated with a particular appointment for a copay.

otheramount.description: The amount being collected that is not associated with individual appointment. This money goes into the "unapplied" bucket. In the future, these payments will be able to be broken down by individual claim level. Co-pay amounts should be in "copayamount".

claimpayment.description: A JSON representation of claim ID and payment combinations.  For example, '[ { "1":"1.00"}, { "2":"5.00"} ].'  This indicates a payment of $1 for claim ID #1 and a payment of $5 for claim ID #2.

todayservice.description: Apply the other amount value to today's service.

paymentmethod.description: Valid values include CASH or CHECK or OTHER PAYMENT[PAYPAL/VENMO etc] or anything as a result of /configuration/validnonccpcreditcardmethods. Note that practices using Credit Card Plus (CCP) should typically NOT be using this call and should instead use the collectpayment endpoints to charge the card. primaryEndpoints.endpointTitle: Record a Patient Payment made via a third party vendor
primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: This API will record when a patient has made a payment via a third party vendor. It is important to note that the third party vendor will actually conduct the transaction. This API is simply for recording that transaction after the fact. Additionally, the third party vendor can use this API to tell athena to tie a given payment to the Copay portion of a patient's balance. Lastly, if the third party vendor is using athena's current Credit Card Processor (CCP), which is Elavon, then they can also provide additional details (i.e. VENDORTERMINALID and BANKDEPOSITDATE) in order to drive automated reconciliation between the movement of the money and the indicated payment transaction.

appointmentid.description: The ID of the appointment where the copay should be applied.

bankdepositdate.description: The date when payment gets deposited to US Bank.

cardnumberlast4.description: The last 4 digits of the credit card number.  This is required if the payment method is a credit card.

checknumber.description: The check number.  This is required if the payment is made by check.

claimpayment.description: A JSON representation of claim ID and payment combinations.  For example, '[ { "1":"1.00"}, { "2":"5.00"} ].'  This indicates a payment of $1 for claim ID #1 and a payment of $5 for claim ID #2.

copayamount.description: The amount associated with a particular appointment for a copay.

departmentid.description: The ID of the department where the payment or contract is being collected.

externalrefid.description: The Vendor side reference for this payment. This is expected to be unique for a vendor as it is the one used for checking if a particular  payment is duplicate of another. Also, in case of any issues, this field will help us with debugging. Maxlength = 32

movetounappliedifoverpay.description: In case of overpay in a particular claim, automatically move the balance amount for that particular claim to unapplied

otheramount.description: The amount being collected that is not associated with individual appointment. This money goes into the "unapplied" bucket. In the future, these payments will be able to be broken down by individual claim level.

patientid.description: The ID of the patient for whom the payment is being made

paymentmethod.description: The vendor-specific payment method by which payment is collected.

postdate.description: The date the payment was made based on Eastern time zone.  Defaulted to today.

todayservice.description: Apply the other amount value to today's service.

vendorterminalid.description: The TID is used to make the CC payment with payment gateway.  This is required if the payment method is a credit card.

patientpaymentid.description: The athena reference for the payment that was recorded. Caller should pass this same reference later on for refunding

previouslyrecordedyn.description:
If the payment was considered a duplicate, then athena will not record the payment, but will set this field to true 
						and return the previously recorded id in PATIENTPAYMENTID field. A payment will be considered duplicate if a will be considered duplicate if a record payment call hapenned for the same patient id and same total payment amount within a period of 6 hours. To avoid getting duplicate payments, use different reference id  in EXTERNALREFID

primaryEndpoints.endpointTitle: Record a Patient Refund made by a third party vendor
primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: This API will record when a patient has been refunded via a third party vendor. It is important to note that the third party vendor will actually move the money back to the patient. This API is simply for recording the transaction after the fact. Additionally, this endpoint only accepts full refunds. If a partial adjustment is needed, please use the Adjustments API.

bankdepositdate.description: The date when the payment gets deposited to US Bank.

departmentid.description: The ID of the department where the refund is issued.

externalrefid.description: The Vendor side reference for this refund. This is expected to be unique for a vendor as it is the one used for checking if a particular refund is duplicate of another. Also, in case of any issues, this field will help us with debugging. Maxlength = 32

fullrefund.description: Currently the only supported value is true. Passing this as false would return an error

ispaymentsettled.description: This input will be used to decide whether the refund needs to be voided or refunded. So based on the Vendor credit card processor settlement time, vendor will decide to use ISPAYMENTSETTLED = true if the actual refund happened after the settlement time

patientid.description: The ID of the patient for whom the payment is made

paymentmethod.description: The vendor-specific payment method by which payment is collected.

postdate.description: The date the payment was made.  Defaulted to today.

vendorterminalid.description: The TID is used to make the CC payment with payment gateway.  This is required if the payment method is a credit card.

recordedtime.description: The time the patient refund was recorded

patientpaymentid.description: The athena reference for the refund that was recorded. Caller should pass this same reference later on for refunding

tags: Patient Pay Vendor Payment and Refunds

primaryEndpoints.endpointTitle: Record an adjustment to a patient balance made by a third party vendor
primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: This API will allow third party vendors to adjust off any portion of a patient balance on each charge line. Note that each adjustment can not exceed the total outstanding charge amount. This endpoint can be used for scenarios where third party vendors may offer discounts (e.g. when a payment is made in full within a certain timeframe). Note that if all charges of a claim are fully adjusted off, the claim will be moved to 'CLOSED'.

chargeid.description: Initial Charge created for a claim that corresponds to the transaction type CHARGE

externalrefid.description: Vendor side reference for the adjustment made

customtransactioncode.description: Custom Transaction code created by the practice

chargeid.description: Charge passed as i/p for applying adjustment

vendoradjustmentid.description: Athena reference to the adjustment made

tags: Post a Patient Pay Vendor adjustment against a charge
